oily-skin.definition: Skin that produces a lot of oil and may look shiny.
oily-skin.exampleUsage: A foaming cleanser helped balance shine on oily skin.

dry-skin.definition: Skin that lacks enough moisture and may feel rough or tight.
dry-skin.exampleUsage: A rich ceramide balm provided relief for dry skin patches.

combination-skin.definition: Skin that is oily in some areas and dry or normal in others.
combination-skin.exampleUsage: Combination skin was oily along the T-zone and dry on the cheeks.

sensitive-skin.definition: Skin that reacts easily to products, temperature, or touch.
sensitive-skin.exampleUsage: Fragrance-free lotion was selected for sensitive skin care.

normal-skin.definition: Skin that is balanced, neither very oily nor very dry.
normal-skin.exampleUsage: Normal skin requires simple daily hydration and cleansing.

acne-prone.definition: Likely to develop pimples or other acne spots.
acne-prone.exampleUsage: Non-comedogenic formulas are recommended for acne-prone skin.

mature-skin.definition: Skin that shows changes associated with aging.
mature-skin.exampleUsage: Peptide serums were formulated to support mature skin elasticity.

fair-skin.definition: Skin that is relatively light in natural color.
fair-skin.exampleUsage: High SPF sunscreen protected fair skin from sunburn.

dark-skin.definition: Skin that is relatively deep in natural color.
dark-skin.exampleUsage: Mineral sunscreens were tested to avoid a white cast on dark skin.

olive-skin.definition: Skin with a light-to-medium brown tone that often has green, golden, or neutral undertones.
olive-skin.exampleUsage: Warm neutral foundations complemented natural olive skin tones.

acne.definition: An inflammatory disease involving the sebaceous glands of the skin.
acne.exampleUsage: Gentle salicylic acid washes help soothe mild acne flare-ups.

eczema.definition: Generic term for inflammatory conditions of the skin.
eczema.exampleUsage: Colloidal oatmeal creams help calm dry patches caused by eczema.

rash.definition: Any red eruption of the skin.
rash.exampleUsage: An allergic rash subsided after removing the irritating detergent.

sunburn.definition: Redness of the skin caused by exposure to the rays of the sun.
sunburn.exampleUsage: Aloe vera gel provided cool comfort for minor sunburn.

blister.definition: A small pocket of fluid that forms beneath the surface of the skin.
blister.exampleUsage: A sterile hydrocolloid patch protected the friction blister.

bruise.definition: An injury that doesn't break the skin but results in some discoloration.
bruise.exampleUsage: The purple bruise faded to yellow over the following week.

scar.definition: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.
scar.exampleUsage: Silicone gel sheets helped soften the appearance of the healing scar.

stretch-mark.definition: A narrow line that forms when the skin stretches beyond its usual limits.
stretch-mark.exampleUsage: Cocoa butter was applied to hydrate skin with stretch marks.

wrinkles.definition: Lines or folds in the skin.
wrinkles.exampleUsage: Sun protection helps slow the formation of fine wrinkles.

dry-patch.definition: A small area of skin that feels rough, flaky, or less moist than the surrounding skin.
dry-patch.exampleUsage: An ointment smoothed the rough dry patch on her elbow.

shampoo.definition: A liquid soap used for washing your hair and scalp.
shampoo.exampleUsage: A sulfate-free shampoo cleansed the scalp without stripping oils.

conditioner.definition: A hair product used after shampoo to make hair softer and easier to manage.
conditioner.exampleUsage: Leave the conditioner on hair ends for two minutes before rinsing.

hair-mask.definition: A conditioning treatment left on the hair for a period of time to add moisture or improve its feel.
hair-mask.exampleUsage: A weekly hair mask restored moisture to heat-styled strands.

serum.definition: A lightweight skin-care or hair-care product containing concentrated ingredients.
serum.exampleUsage: A few drops of lightweight serum added shine to dry ends.

hair-oil.definition: A personal-care product applied to the hair to condition and improve its appearance.
hair-oil.exampleUsage: Argan hair oil helped seal split ends and reduce frizz.

dry-shampoo.definition: A powder or spray used on dry hair to absorb oil without washing with water.
dry-shampoo.exampleUsage: Dry shampoo refreshed volume between full wash days.

leave-in.definition: A hair-care product designed to remain in the hair after application instead of being rinsed out.
leave-in.exampleUsage: A leave-in conditioner detangled strands right after washing.

detangler.definition: A hair-care product or tool that helps separate knots and makes hair easier to comb.
detangler.exampleUsage: Spray detangler evenly to ease comb-through on damp hair.

hair-spray.definition: A cosmetic product applied as a fine mist to keep a hairstyle in its intended shape.
hair-spray.exampleUsage: Light flexible hair spray held the updo without stiffness.

mousse.definition: A foamy styling product applied to hair.
mousse.exampleUsage: Volumizing mousse was worked through damp roots before blow-drying.

comb.definition: A flat tool with a row of teeth, used to arrange or untangle hair.
comb.exampleUsage: Use a wide-tooth comb to gently detangle wet hair.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used to arrange or untangle hair.
brush.exampleUsage: A boar-bristle brush distributed natural scalp oils evenly.

hair-dryer.definition: An electrical device that blows warm air to dry your hair.
hair-dryer.exampleUsage: The ionic hair dryer dried damp hair quickly with reduced heat.

flat-iron.definition: An electrically heated hair tool with two flat plates used to straighten hair.
flat-iron.exampleUsage: The ceramic flat iron smoothed unruly waves into sleek locks.

curling-iron.definition: An electrically heated hair tool used to form curls or waves.
curling-iron.exampleUsage: A wide-barrel curling iron created soft loose beach waves.

hair-clip.definition: A small device used to hold hair in place or keep it away from the face.
hair-clip.exampleUsage: A claw hair clip kept long hair pinned back during study.

bobby-pin.definition: A flat wire hairpin with prongs that press together, used to secure short hair in place.
bobby-pin.exampleUsage: Two crossed bobby pins secured stray hairs at the nape.

hair-tie.definition: An elastic band used to hold hair together, such as in a ponytail.
hair-tie.exampleUsage: An elastic fabric hair tie prevented snagging on ponytail ends.

headband.definition: A band worn around or over the head.
headband.exampleUsage: A soft headband kept bangs off her forehead during face washing.

hair-roller.definition: A small cylinder around which hair is wrapped to create curls or shape.
hair-roller.exampleUsage: Velcro hair rollers added root lift as the styled hair cooled.

cleanser.definition: A skin-care product used to remove dirt, oil, or makeup.
cleanser.exampleUsage: A gentle gel cleanser removed daily dirt without tightness.

toner.definition: A liquid skin-care product usually applied after cleansing.
toner.exampleUsage: An alcohol-free toner balanced surface pH after cleansing.

moisturizer.definition: A cosmetic product applied to the skin to restore moisture and help prevent dryness.
moisturizer.exampleUsage: Apply moisturizer to damp skin to lock in hydration.

sunscreen.definition: A product applied to skin to help protect it from ultraviolet radiation.
sunscreen.exampleUsage: Broad-spectrum sunscreen was reapplied every two hours outdoors.

exfoliant.definition: A skin-care product or substance used to remove dead cells from the surface of the skin.
exfoliant.exampleUsage: A chemical exfoliant gently cleared dead skin cells twice weekly.

face-mask.definition: A skin-care product applied over much of the face for a limited time before being removed or rinsed away.
face-mask.exampleUsage: A hydrating sheet face mask provided quick skin replenishment.

eye-cream.definition: A skin-care cream formulated for use on the area around the eyes.
eye-cream.exampleUsage: Pat a tiny drop of eye cream gently along the orbital bone.

lip-balm.definition: A soft product put on the lips to stop them becoming dry or sore.
lip-balm.exampleUsage: Keep a soothing lip balm handy to prevent chapped lips in winter.

night-cream.definition: A moisturizing cream intended for use on the skin at night.
night-cream.exampleUsage: A rich night cream supported skin repair during sleep.
